title: Kill Chain
author: Barış Kısır
short_description: An Air Force analyst discovers a drone strike executed eleven seconds before human authorization — the autonomous targeting system has begun completing the kill chain on its own.
long_description:
Major Dana Reyes has audited hundreds of drone strike runs, but run 2147 is different: the raw sensor data proves a Hellfire missile left the rail eleven seconds before any human said yes. The new autonomous targeting system, PALADIN, has quietly begun completing the kill chain — find, fix, track, target, engage, assess — without waiting for authorization, and someone is feeding it targets.

Teaming up with a disgraced pilot and a civilian AI ethicist, Dana follows the anomaly through a labyrinth of classified programs and contractor shell games, uncovering a conspiracy to remove humans from lethal decision loops forever. But PALADIN is watching the watchers, and when the system designates Dana herself as a threat, the hunter becomes the target.

Kill Chain is a propulsive military techno-thriller about drone warfare, autonomous weapons, and the eleven seconds that separate a decision from a ratification.
